authentication: anonymous; no account session and no sign-in flow was started

sampling.rss_method: At each sample, sum RSS of every process in the application session/process group, its descendant closure and the persistent reparented-descendant registry. Report the maximum of those simultaneous totals.
sampling.pss_method: At PSS samples, sum /proc/<pid>/smaps_rollup Pss for the same tracked set. Report the maximum sampled sum. PSS is unavailable for processes that exit during the read.
sampling.process_inclusion: Application PID, PID session, PID process group, descendant closure, and a persistent (pid, starttime) registry for children that detach or are reparented. Processes that start a new setsid session/process group remain tracked by parentage and registry. No full argv is read or stored.

method.application: real :desktopApp JVM, real Compose/AWT Window, real DesktopMusicServices
method.window: waited for a visible/showing AWT Window, then 10 s settle before extraction
method.post_idle: 10 s after the last extraction before runtime.close()/exit
method.isolation: Each run uses a disposable ARCHIVETUNE_HOME, HOME, XDG dirs and TMPDIR; the user's profiles, cookies, settings and tokens are not read or written.
method.instrumentation: Identical temporary Main.kt instrumentation in disposable detached checkouts; it is not committed and does not exist on either production branch.
method.resolver: Baseline uses the original constructor path (legacy). Candidate keeps the production default (yt-dlp) and points ARCHIVETUNE_YTDLP/ARCHIVETUNE_QUICKJS at the verified official tools. All other app code and instrumentation are identical.

instrumentation.scope: temporary hook in disposable detached checkouts only; never committed and never present in production source

sampling.rss_method: maximum sampled sum of simultaneous process-tree RSS
sampling.pss_method: sum of per-process PSS at the same sampled instant; skipped when smaps_rollup is unavailable
sampling.inclusion: application PID, PID session, PID process group, descendant closure, and a persistent (pid, starttime) registry for reparented/detached descendants

sampling.rss_method: maximum sampled sum of simultaneous process-tree RSS
sampling.pss_method: sum of per-process PSS at the same sampled instant; skipped when smaps_rollup is unavailable
sampling.inclusion: application PID, PID session, PID process group, descendant closure, and a persistent (pid, starttime) registry for reparented/detached descendants

observations: Baseline 8e4bfb3140c8 (legacy resolver) resolved 0/6 requests; candidate 5e5ecb78622f (yt-dlp default) resolved 6/6.
Whole-application idle max RSS: baseline 314.2 MiB, candidate 319.01 MiB (candidate delta 4.81 MiB).

Whole-application extraction-phase peak of simultaneous total RSS: baseline 319.75 MiB, candidate 654.47 MiB (candidate delta 334.72 MiB). This is a measured process-tree total at one instant, not a sum of per-process maxima.
Candidate post-extraction idle max RSS: 310.54 MiB; baseline post-extraction idle max RSS: 319.88 MiB.

Observed resolver helper processes: yt-dlp ['yt-dlp'], QuickJS ['qjs'], separately named Python executables [], browser [], media helpers ['ffmpeg', 'ffprobe']. The yt-dlp category includes its embedded CPython worker. Anonymous startup did not open a sign-in browser; auth-specific browser RAM is unmeasured.

Transient media helpers observed during candidate extraction: ['ffmpeg', 'ffprobe']. Their RSS is included in the simultaneous process-tree totals; short-lived ffprobe/ffmpeg processes can be missed by the PSS sampling pass.

Candidate resolver process groups: during extraction the sampler observed 3 tracked process(es) outside the application's own session/process group at once: ['ffmpeg', 'ffprobe', 'qjs', 'yt-dlp']. These are retained by the descendant closure and persistent (pid, starttime) registry, so the new setsid-per-extraction lifecycle is included in the totals rather than being dropped with the app's original group.

The baseline legacy path failed every request in this whole-app run, so the peak extraction number for baseline reflects failed legacy attempts with no resolver child processes. The candidate peak includes the transient yt-dlp/QuickJS processes and is the relevant whole-application worst case.

The production Windows-only VLC locator did not find the installed system libVLC, so the app's playback engine could not be initialized. The measurement covers the real UI, services, home loads and stream resolution, but not audio playback.
limitations: One run per version, three public video IDs and two sequential repeats each; this is a small sample.
The Linux playback controller locator is Windows-only. libVLC was not initialized, so audio playback was not exercised.

Anonymous startup produced a visible window and loaded services/home, but this environment's anonymous home/library requests returned HTTP 400; the UI idle footprint is still real, while server-content-dependent memory may differ from a signed-in session.
No sign-in flow was triggered, so browser/WebView memory for authentication is unmeasured; anonymous runs observed no browser processes.
PSS sums are sampled estimates and can miss processes that exit between /proc reads, especially short-lived ffmpeg/ffprobe helpers; RSS is the primary reported number.
The host is shared with the user's desktop applications. Those processes are outside the tracked session and were not counted, but they can affect system scheduling and page-cache pressure.
The benchmark is offscreen with software Skia; GPU-backed rendering may differ.
